segments.text: No, no, your name is Gautam, my name.
I don't know, in the app, in the ID, it shows that.
Okay, okay, I am also married.
Your voice sounded like you were not married, so I asked.
Okay, okay, are they going to school?
The elder one is in LKG.
The younger one is two years old.
Okay, are you native to Salem?
I shifted here five months ago.
Okay, where in Salem are you?
I am two years older than you.
Leave it, it's okay, let it be. What does it matter?
Should I not talk, or is 31 not okay?
If you are okay, then tell me.
Your voice is good. Thank you.
What did you say? I didn't understand.
No, you were asking something, tell me. I was asking in between, sorry.
I didn't ask anything. Where is your wife?
Okay, has she gone to her hometown?
That's why you came here to be alone, right?
More than me, you are the one who is alone.
Why are you saying that? Oh, I have come here permanently, right?
How many kids do you have?
Only one girl, three years old.
It's been three or four years since the marriage, right?
This time, your voice is very clear. I can hear the water sound.
What are you doing? Are you not sleeping?
No, no, I am just holding the phone near my mouth and talking.
Are you staying with your in-laws, or are you staying separately?
I don't have my father-in-law or mother-in-law. They have passed away.
How are you staying alone without anyone?
I took a house, I took a house.
Okay, okay, you took a house.
Actually, I have my own house here. My mother's house is nearby, and I have my own house.
I have some construction work, so I have to finish the pending work.
So, until then, I am staying in a rented house. They are all supporting me.
That's what I asked. How are you staying alone without anyone?
It's not like that. They are all nearby. My mother, grandfather, grandmother, mother, father, my family, my aunt's family, my brother's family.
Okay, okay, I asked that. So, you are staying alone in Attur, right?
Yes, this is the place where I was born and brought up. Actually, I got married in Chennai ten years ago.
It's been ten years, and I have just come back.
No, for now, there is no work. The kids are small.
How long have you been using this app?
I installed it a long time ago, but I am not a regular user. I come occasionally.
Same here. My wife uses it only when she goes out, otherwise I don't.
Are you afraid of your wife?
No, I am not afraid. It's just that I don't need any unnecessary problems.
How is she? Is she okay?
She is okay. She is not too strict, not too liberal, she is okay.
Do you like your wife very much?
I don't like her very much, 70%. The remaining 30% is because we fight sometimes.
What did she study, and what did you study?
I am a mechanical engineer, and she is an MSc BEd.
Yes, I am a chemistry graduate.
Okay, I am a physics graduate.
So, since you have kids, you don't go to work, right?
It's going on. How about you? How do you like your husband?
My husband and I are not compatible.
From the beginning, it has been like that.
His character and mine are not compatible, and it won't be compatible with anyone else.
I am not saying he has flaws, he is a very, very, very good person.
He is a great human being, has a great helping tendency, and is the best father in this world.
He is the best son, and a good disciple to his guru.
But if you ask if he is a great husband, that doesn't come to him.
He grew up in a different way, and there is a big age difference between us.
Okay, is it a big age difference?
He grew up in that generation, and women in that generation, like his mother, lived in a way where they didn't answer back to anyone.
They would hide behind the door and answer.
He expects the same thing from me, how is that possible?
So, you are in a different generation.
If I say, 'Hey, give me tea or coffee,' he will say, 'I will give it to you ten times,' but he will not give it.
He will say, 'I will give it,' but he won't.
If I say, 'Hey, give me tea,' he won't do it if he doesn't want to.
That is his nature. That is how he talks, his tone, everything.
I am also educated, and I have lived a better life than him.
I am an educated girl, and I was young.
Then why did you marry at that age?
That is a different issue, leave it.
Actually, you are talking about such a sad thing with a smile.
That is because I am used to it.
Because I have come out of it.
I don't have any purity in my mind because he has hurt me so much.
Like, now, how do I say?
I will tell you one thing, and you will understand it completely.
Like, now, at my house in Chennai, people come to clean the house and wash the dishes.
Until then, he will talk to me nicely, laughing and talking in the morning.
But when it is 10 o'clock, when I enter, he will call me names, he will call me names.
I will think, 'I was talking nicely until now, why is he doing this?'
I want to insult him in front of someone.
If you want to insult your wife in front of a third person, it means you don't have love for her.
If you really had love for her, you wouldn't do that.
Even if you did, we would talk within the four walls, that's okay.
Yes, yes, I am not saying that I am wrong.
I am not saying I am wrong, I wouldn't do that.
Has anything like that happened, like him talking to you?
I am asking if anything wrong has happened.
No, I am asking if he did something wrong.
Yes, he does this a lot.
This is how he treats me, this is how it is.
I have never taken money from his pocket.
He will say that I took it.
Why would I take money from his pocket? He will shout in front of others, like it's falling into his ears.
Why would I take money from his pocket? Don't you have any shame?
How many times should I tell you not to take money from my pocket?
If you put your hand, it won't come, don't you know that?
Okay, okay, okay, he is talking like that.
How can we live with a person like that?
He won't divorce, he won't give a divorce.
No, I am asking openly. There is nothing wrong with it. You can share as much as you want.
Like that, we can be friends, but beyond that, I don't want anything else.
I don't want anything, I can tell you face-to-face, there is no problem.
You tell me, we can be friends.
Yes, we can be friends. To be honest, I am a little busy.
I have to pick up and drop off the kids, and do other things, and then I have tuition in the evening.
No, no, I will tell you. Whenever you are free and feel like talking, you can call me.
If you say friendship, that's okay.
Yes, but the thing is, I don't have time.
After that, I will share my ID with you, and I don't have the heart to let you suffer.
No, that's not needed. Just give me your number, I will send a 'Hi' on WhatsApp.
No, I don't want to give my number. I can give my Telegram ID.
No, actually, I am telling you, people use WhatsApp, that's why I am saying.
If not, I can give it, there is no problem.
Everything, WhatsApp, Telegram, everything is used. I will save it in my company's official number.
My problem is the same. I have a little fear, that's the thing.
No, it's nothing. If you give me your number, I will just say 'Hi' when you are free.
Other than that, nothing else. Because you will give it to your husband, right?
Okay, we can talk, we can talk a little.
No, take your time, please cut it after that. You said so much, I felt a bit strange, that's why I cut it quickly.
You are so hurt, that's why I didn't ask for your number immediately.
I am hurt, but I have come out of it.
How to say, it happened like that.
It just, if you ask if I am hurt now, I am not hurt.
Why? Because I don't expect anything from him.
If I expect something, it will hurt me.
What did you eat for dinner?
When do you sleep, and when do you wake up in the morning?
I am awake today, but I won't be awake tomorrow.
Every day is a different story.
Sharmila, don't cut it, share your number and go, please.
But I can't talk, are you okay with that?
No, I will message you. You can call me when you are free, I have no problem.
I will repeat the number once.
There will be a photo of my kid.
The message has come, is the DP not there?
Yes, yes, I got the number.
Okay, I will save it. I will message you later.
I haven't shared my number with anyone until now.
I will tell you how to call me, what to do, everything in detail on WhatsApp.
I am a bit scared, this is the first time I am doing this.
I won't torture you, don't worry.
Just one minute, I will call you on that, WhatsApp call or voice call?
Don't do it, don't do it, don't do it.
